Entry Point 01 / 12

1. Energy Price Cap & Tariff Regulation

Ofgem's price cap limits default tariff rates for ~15 million households, reviewed quarterly using wholesale costs, network charges, and policy costs.

Compliance Automation

Verify tariff submissions against cap methodology. Cross-check rates via mcp-uk-legislation and mcp-ofgem-ai-governance.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Monitor wholesale volatility. Flag suppliers at risk of breaching cap thresholds via mcp-desnz-energy-data.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

Parse cap methodology and consultations. Summarise changes via mcp-govuk-search.

Predictive Analytics

Forecast quarterly cap levels from wholesale futures and network costs. Model consumer impact.

Evidence Synthesis

Synthesise consultation responses and academic evidence on cap effectiveness.

Document Intelligence

Extract data from tariff submissions. Auto-classify cap correspondence via mcp-ofgem-ai-governance.

Stakeholder Reporting

Quarterly cap impact reports for Select Committee via mcp-hansard-search.

Real-time Monitoring

Live wholesale vs cap headroom dashboard. Alert on early review conditions via mcp-desnz-energy-data.

Entry Point 02 / 12

2. Network Price Controls (RIIO-2)

RIIO-2 sets 5-year price controls for DNOs, TNOs, and ESO, determining allowed revenues, efficiency challenges, and output incentives.

Compliance Automation

Validate business plans against RIIO-2 outputs via mcp-ofgem-ai-governance and mcp-uk-legislation.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Flag network companies at risk of underperformance. Monitor adjustment factors.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

Analyse determinations and extract key decisions via mcp-govuk-search.

Predictive Analytics

Model performance trajectories. Forecast expenditure allowances via mcp-energy-networks-data.

Evidence Synthesis

Synthesise business plans, consumer input, and industry evidence for justification dossiers.

Document Intelligence

Extract financial data from submissions. Automate monitoring reports via mcp-ofgem-ai-governance.

Stakeholder Reporting

Performance dashboards and benchmarking reports for Ofgem Board.

Real-time Monitoring

Track output scores, queue times, and interruption metrics via mcp-energy-networks-data.

3. Consumer Protection & Complaints

Ofgem enforces billing, switching, and complaints obligations through Standards of Conduct and Guaranteed Standards of Performance.

Compliance Automation

Automate complaints handling checks. Cross-reference Ombudsman data via mcp-uk-legislation.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Identify suppliers with rising complaints. Flag emerging consumer harm patterns.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

Parse protection regulations and licence conditions via mcp-govuk-search.

Predictive Analytics

Forecast complaint volumes by supplier. Predict harm trends from billing/switching data.

Evidence Synthesis

Aggregate consumer group submissions, Ombudsman reports, and fairness research.

Document Intelligence

Auto-classify complaints by type and severity. Extract facts via mcp-ofgem-ai-governance.

Stakeholder Reporting

Supplier league tables. Annual reports via mcp-hansard-search.

Real-time Monitoring

Live complaint volumes, switching delays, and billing errors. Automated alerts.

Ofgem enforces regulations through licence monitoring, investigations, and penalties reaching tens of millions for billing, smart meter, and consumer protection breaches.

12. Parliamentary Accountability

Ofgem is accountable via DESNZ Select Committee, PQs, and NAO. The Energy Act 2023 expanded its remit. Ofgem must justify decisions and produce statutory reports.

Compliance Automation

Track PQ responses and committee recommendations. Monitor statutory reporting via mcp-uk-legislation.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Flag upcoming debates. Detect political pressure via mcp-hansard-search.

Analyse Energy Act 2023 and committee reports via mcp-uk-legislation.

Predictive Analytics

Forecast scrutiny priorities. Model legislative pipeline changes.

Evidence Synthesis

Synthesise evidence sessions, NAO reports, and PAC findings.

Document Intelligence

Process transcripts and PQs. Extract recommendations and track implementation.

Stakeholder Reporting

Select committee briefings. Annual reports and NAO submissions.

Real-time Monitoring

Monitor Hansard for Ofgem activity. Track committee schedules via mcp-hansard-search.
